title: 30-second zombie-survival cinematic, 14 timecoded shots
prompt_text: CINEMATIC SHORT, exactly 30 seconds, one single video, 16:9, photorealistic live-action zombie survival thriller, warm golden-hour sunset light over the sea, orange-teal cinematic grade, dramatic and emotional, handheld high-energy camera, fast cuts. Same characters, outfits and world in every shot. CHARACTERS: - <<<image_1>>> – keep her exact face, skin tone, brown eyes and long naturally wavy light-brown hair from <<<image_1>>> in every shot. Outfit: olive-green hooded parka jacket, black fitted pants, white sneakers. She is brave, desperate and determined, on a mission to reach her friend. - The second girl (the one she is trying to reach): a young Korean girl with black hair in a high ponytail, wearing a bright yellow hoodie, denim shorts, white socks and white sneakers, terrified and screaming. - The zombies: pale grey-skinned infected people in white and light-grey hospital-style robes and gowns, dark hair, blank hungry faces, moving in huge crowds; they crawl, leap and grab. WORLD: a luxury seaside resort hotel at sunset – several large multi-storey beige hotel towers around a courtyard swimming pool, flat gravel rooftops, a huge white inflatable stunt air cushion floating in the middle of the pool, the pool packed with hundreds of zombies, the open golden sea beyond the roof. 0:00–0:01.5 | SHOT 1 | Back-view shot from behind, fast real-time speed, handheld. <<<image_1>>> runs flat out across a gravel rooftop toward the roof edge and the golden sea in the distance, her parka flapping; pale zombie hands reach into the frame from both sides, clawing at her. 0:01.5–0:03.5 | SHOT 2 | High-angle top-down shot, real-time speed. Far below, the courtyard pool is packed with hundreds of dark-haired zombies around a white inflatable air cushion; <<<image_1>>> drops from the roof and lands on the cushion, a tiny figure. Zombies in grey robes leap off the roof edge right after her, flipping through the air. 0:03.5–0:05 | SHOT 3 | Low-angle shot from water level, slight slow motion (about 60% speed). The white cushion bulges and ripples like a giant whale back under the impact; a crowd of zombie swimmers in the pool reach up with their hands, and a huge white water splash explodes as zombies hit the water in the foreground. 0:05–0:06.5 | SHOT 4 | Top-down falling shot, fast real-time speed, then a quick low-angle shot of the sky. The yellow-hoodie girl falls screaming toward the pool, mouth wide open, hood flapping, face tumbling near the camera; cut to a tiny yellow figure flipping in the sky above a hotel tower. 0:06.5–0:08.5 | SHOT 5 | Low-angle then side shot, fast real-time speed. She leaps off a rooftop ledge across to the next building, lands on the edge, somersaults and rolls hard across a gravel rooftop, ending lying on her back, gasping, a small hut and the sea behind. 0:08.5–0:10 | SHOT 6 | Low tracking shot on top of the inflatable cushion, fast real-time speed. <<<image_1>>> sprints along the cushion in her olive parka past fallen zombies lying in grey robes, hotel blocks looming behind, water splashing at the sides. 0:10–0:11.5 | SHOT 7 | Low-angle shot from below a rooftop wall, real-time speed. The yellow-hoodie girl clings to the top edge of the wall with her forearms and one arm stretched out, screaming for help, a golden-brown wall and pale sky behind her. 0:11.5–0:14.5 | SHOT 8 | Low-angle tracking shot along the cushion, real-time speed. <<<image_1>>> crawls on her hands and knees along the white cushion, a grey-robed zombie crawling right beside her, pale hands grabbing at the lower edge of the frame, the pool and hotel blocks behind; she pushes forward, hair swinging, breathing hard. 0:14.5–0:16 | SHOT 9 | High-angle top-down shot, real-time speed. A huge crowd of zombies in white robes surges and climbs over each other around the white cushion, dozens of upturned backs, while tiny <<<image_1>>> clings to the top end of the cushion above the bright blue water. 0:16–0:18 | SHOT 10 | Wide low-angle shot, slow motion (about 60% speed). The giant white cushion buckles in the middle and tips up vertically while zombies and debris fly off a hotel roof in the sky behind; <<<image_1>>> clings to the cushion's top, dark hair whipping, hotel tower behind. 0:18–0:21 | SHOT 11 | Vertical top-down aerial shot following her fall, fast real-time speed. <<<image_1>>> plunges down along the side of the hotel tower toward the courtyard and pool below, arms and parka flapping, a zombie in a white robe tumbling beside her, then she slams into the rooftop edge of the lower building. 0:21–0:22 | SHOT 12 | Blurred side shot, fast real-time speed, sunset glow. <<<image_1>>> tumbles and rolls across the gravel rooftop in a blur of motion, hair and parka whipping. 0:22–0:26 | SHOT 13 | Medium shot at gravel level, slow and emotional (about 80% speed). The two girls kneel facing each other on the rooftop at golden hour and press their foreheads together, breathing hard, tearful relief, hotel wall behind them. Then zombies crawl in from behind them across the gravel; <<<image_1>>> looks up in alarm, lunges across and grabs the yellow-hoodie girl's hand, pulling her to her feet as zombies reach toward them. 0:26–0:30 | SHOT 14 | Wide shot from behind, mostly real-time with a slight slow-down at the leap. The two girls, hand in hand, run to the roof edge and leap together into the air over the glittering golden sunset sea, tiny against the water; two zombies leap off the roof behind them, arms outstretched. End on the two girls in mid-air above the sea.

title: Pixar-style 3D tropical forest adventure, 6 scenes
prompt_text:
AI Video Prompt

Create a magical, heartwarming, high-quality 3D animated fantasy adventure set in a lush tropical forest filled with warm golden sunlight, vibrant green foliage, and beautiful natural scenery.
Scene 1 – The Magical Nest
A cute little toddler girl with big expressive eyes and dark brown hair tied in a tiny bun sits inside a large bird's nest resting on a thick tree branch. She is surrounded by adorable fluffy baby birds in different pastel colors, including pink, blue, purple, yellow, and green. A tiny orange crab is sitting beside her. The baby birds cuddle around the little girl as she smiles with excitement.
Scene 2 – The Baby Birds Escape
Suddenly, the colorful fluffy baby birds begin flying out of the nest, one after another. Their tiny wings flutter rapidly as they float through the air. The little girl looks surprised and excited, watching them leave. The orange crab follows the movement with its curious eyes.
Scene 3 – The Adventure Across the Branch
The toddler crawls along the large curved tree branch, trying to follow the adorable flying birds. The colorful creatures move ahead playfully, occasionally landing on the branch and looking back at her. Show beautiful close-up shots of their expressive faces and playful reactions.
Scene 4 – The Colorful Parade
A wide cinematic shot reveals several adorable pastel-colored baby birds lined up along a long tree branch. The little girl watches them with excitement while the tiny orange crab accompanies her. The birds create a magical, colorful visual against the lush forest background.
Scene 5 – The Magical Landing
The colorful baby birds and the little girl arrive at a huge, soft bed of fluffy white and pink flower petals on the forest floor. The girl joyfully jumps into the soft petals while the adorable birds gather around her. The little orange crab playfully joins them.
Scene 6 – The Happy Ending
The toddler sits happily among the colorful fluffy baby birds, wearing a beautiful pink floral crown. She laughs with pure happiness as the birds bounce around her. Pink and white flower petals gently fall through the air, creating a magical fairytale atmosphere. Finish with a beautiful wide cinematic shot of the entire group smiling together.
Visual Style & Quality:
- Premium Pixar-inspired 3D animation.
- Extremely cute and expressive characters.
- Soft fluffy feathers and realistic detailed textures.
- Vibrant tropical forest environment.
- Warm golden-hour lighting and cinematic depth of field.
- Smooth character animation and natural movements.
- Beautiful facial expressions and emotional storytelling.
- Magical atmosphere with floating flower petals.
- Professional cinematic camera movements.
- Consistent character appearance throughout all scenes.
Format: 16:9 widescreen, approximately 25 seconds, 30 FPS, ultra-high-quality 3D animated cinematic video.
Important: Maintain consistent character designs, natural movement, smooth scene transitions, and a joyful fairytale atmosphere throughout the entire video.
